import { useState } from 'react';
import { InputText } from './input-text';

### Usages

InputText component with error and success props.  
Supports all props from native html input.

InputText example:

```js live
() => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');
  return (
    <InputText
      error={value === 'error'}
      placeholder="placeholder"
      success={value === 'success'}
      onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
    />
  );
};
```

InputText with icon:

```js live
<InputText
  placeholder="search..."
  icon={
    <img
      src="https://static.bit.dev/bit-icons/filter.svg"
      style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
      onClick={() => alert('on icon click')}
      width='16px'
    />
  }
/>
```

Error input text with message

```js live
<InputText
  error
  message="error message to be displayed in the tooltip"
  placeholder="placeholder"
/>
```
